programs.name: REVIVE Legacy Revival
programs.reward: RVIV pool: 20,000,000 tokens across the recorded 216 eligible wallets
programs.eligibility: Existing recorded snapshot entitlement; exact wallet and amount must match the approved ledger.
programs.proof: Wallet signature against the published claim challenge after launch; no seed phrase or token transfer.

programs.name: DevCity™ 100
programs.reward: Planned 200,000 RVIV per approved seat; 100 seats maximum
programs.eligibility: Accepted DevCity participation, developer evidence and verified Solana wallet association. Public candidate wallets are not approved seats.
programs.proof: Program approval and signed wallet challenge once a claim flow is published.

programs.name: Community Support
programs.reward: Support varies by the specific community project; no token reward is promised
programs.eligibility: Each project sets its own eligibility and verification process.
programs.proof: Follow the chosen project's published support pathway; wallet ownership is not required for ordinary donations.
